metadata.title: Pesly
metadata.description: Your personal and shared finances, in pesos and dollars, even offline.

home.title: Pesly
home.tagline: Your accounts, expenses and savings in pesos and dollars, in one place.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Manage your pesos and dollars in one place.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for that email, we sent a link to reset the password. It expires in 60 minutes.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Your new password ends every open session.
resetPassword.success: Your password was changed and every open session was closed. Sign in with the new password.

verifyEmail.title: Email verification
verifyEmail.verified: Your email is verified. You can now use Pesly.
verifyEmail.resent: We sent a new link to your email.

checkYourEmail.title: Check your email
checkYourEmail.description: We sent a verification link to your email. Open it to activate your account; it expires in 24 hours.
checkYourEmail.resent: We sent a new link to your email.

secondFactor.title: Two-step verification
secondFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
secondFactor.recoveryDescription: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works only once.

errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 10 characters long.
errors.passwordBreached: This password appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password can be at most 128 characters long.
errors.displayNameTooLong: The display name can be at most 50 characters long.

errors.retryLater: Too many attempts or the service is busy. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: We could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.validationFailed: Check the data you entered and try again.
errors.googleFailed: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
errors.codeInvalid: The code is not valid or was already used. Try again.
errors.secondFactorExpired: The verification expired. Sign in again.
errors.twoFactorSetupRequired: The setup changed in another session. Start again.

errors.accountHasMovements: This account has movements, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
errors.categoryNameTaken: You already have a category with that name.

errors.categoryParentKindMismatch: A subcategory must have the same kind as its parent.

errors.totpCodeFormat: Enter the 6 digits of the code.
errors.secondFactorCodeFormat: Enter a 6-digit code or a recovery code.

new.description: Add a place where you keep your money.

fields.name: Name
fields.openingBalanceHint: Optional. Use a minus sign for a negative balance.

list.empty: You have no accounts yet. Create one to get started.

errors.nameTooLong: The name can be at most {max} characters long.
errors.nameInvalidCharacters: The name contains characters that cannot be shown. Remove them and try again.
errors.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 1,500.00.
errors.amountOutOfRange: The opening balance cannot exceed {max} in absolute value.

new.description: Add a category or a subcategory of your own.

errors.nameTooLong: The name can be at most {max} characters long.

security.title: Security
security.enabledNotice: You turned on two-step verification. We signed you out of your other sessions.
security.disabledNotice: You turned off two-step verification. We signed you out of your other sessions.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Besides your password or Google, we will ask for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in.

setup.title: Turn on two-step verification
setup.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
setup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.manual: If you cannot scan it, enter this key in the app:
setup.codeHint: Enter the code shown by the app to confirm.

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.description: If you lose your authenticator app, each code lets you sign in once. We will not show them again.
recoveryCodes.copyFailed: We could not copy them. Download them or write them down.
recoveryCodes.fileHeader: Pesly recovery codes. Each one works only once.

disable.title: Turn off two-step verification
disable.description: Enter a code from your authenticator app or an unused recovery code.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently remove your account and all its data.

errors.displayNameTooLong: The display name can be at most 50 characters long.
errors.timeZoneInvalid: Choose a time zone from the list.

deleteUser.title: Delete account
deleteUser.description: Deleting your account removes it and everything in it.
deleteUser.warning: We will permanently delete your account, your accounts and every movement. There is no way to recover them.
deleteUser.codeHint: A 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or an unused recovery code.

google.description: Your account has no password. Confirm it is you by signing in with Google again.
google.confirmed: Google confirmed it is you. Finish within 5 minutes.
google.failed: We could not confirm it with Google. Try again.

setPassword.title: No password and Google cannot confirm you?
setPassword.body: If your account has no password and Google cannot confirm it is you, set a password first with the forgot-password flow, then come back to delete your account.
setPassword.note: No password and Google cannot confirm you? Set a password first.
setPassword.link: Set a password with forgot password
